recipes.name: service-tests
recipes.purpose: Service end-to-end with batched inference, dedup across feeds, 409 and failure paths (needs only aiohttp and pytest).

recipes.name: batch-equivalence
recipes.command: PY=python3; [ -x .venv/bin/python ] && PY=.venv/bin/python; if ! $PY -c 'import torch, transformers' 2>/dev/null; then echo 'torch/transformers unavailable here; skipping'; exit 0; fi; $PY -m pytest -q serving/tests/test_batch.py
recipes.purpose: predict_batch/predict_ids on mixed-length headlines matches per-item predict (same direction, confidence within 1e-4) on a tiny random BERT. Skips (exit 0) only when torch/transformers cannot be imported; any test failure fails the recipe.

recipes.name: fused-equivalence
recipes.command: PY=python3; [ -x .venv/bin/python ] && PY=.venv/bin/python; if ! $PY -c 'import torch, transformers' 2>/dev/null; then echo 'torch/transformers unavailable here; skipping'; exit 0; fi; $PY -m pytest -q serving/tests/test_fused.py
recipes.purpose: FusedBert fp32 CPU matches HF probs (<1e-4, same argmax) with SDPA and explicit attention, padding rows do not change real rows, and _capture uses the fused forward rather than self.model.

recipes.name: native-runtime
recipes.command: PY=python3; [ -x .venv/bin/python ] && PY=.venv/bin/python; if ! $PY -c 'import torch, transformers' 2>/dev/null; then echo 'torch/transformers unavailable here; skipping'; exit 0; fi; $PY -m pytest -q serving/tests/test_native.py
recipes.purpose: Native binary: tokenizer parity with HF on adversarial strings and a CPU end-to-end run against a fake newsd (ws+poll, dedup, POST); skips when the ROCm-torch build is unavailable.
